name: Stone of Natural Form
body:
Price 3,000 gp; Aura moderate abjuration; CL 9; Weight 0.5

DESCRIPTION

This small stone is imbued with the magic to free creatures from being stuck in a form not their own.

The stone, if pressed against a creature who is under the effects of a polymorph spell or effect, dissolves and the target is instantly returned to their natural form.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells break enchantment
